title: Casper and the Signal
author: Wendell Pemberton
blurb: Sable Eastwick, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
